pairs.question: Uis tu consuetis, audax conuiua, canistris impleri panisque tui nouisse colorem?
pairs.answer: Scilicet hoc fuerat, propter quod saepe relicta coniuge per montem aduersum gelidasque cucurri Esquilias, fremeret saeua cum grandine uernus Iuppiter et multo stillaret paenula nimbo.
pairs.derivation: Direct-speech exchange. A servant taunts the guest with a real interrogative (uis tu...?, 'do you want to be filled from your usual baskets and know the colour of your own bread?'). The guest Trebius answers with a complete bitter retort ('so THIS was the reason I ran...'). Stripped the inline verse number 75 from after 'colorem' and the embedding quotes. The answer ends at the full stop after 'nimbo'; the next line begins a new authorial section ('aspice quam longo...'). Other ?-bearing lines (8-11, 18-19, 62-65, 129-131) are authorial rhetorical questions with no clean answering span, so dropped.
